html:
The Zuni are a Pueblo people of western New Mexico, on the Zuni River. In the 1500s they lived in six towns, among them Hawikuh. Their language is an isolate, unrelated to any other.

They were the first Pueblo people the Spanish reached. In 1539 an advance party under the African explorer Estevanico arrived from Mexico looking for the rumoured Seven Cities of Cíbola; the Zuni killed him. In 1540 Francisco Vázquez de Coronado took Hawikuh by force and found no gold. Spanish missions came later, and the Zuni joined the Pueblo Revolt of 1680. Afterwards they gathered into a single town, today's Zuni Pueblo. They are known for fine silver and turquoise jewellery and stone fetish carvings. See Shiwinna.
